blocks.text: Application Segment Import allows you to bulk import database files for faster application segment configuration for new and existing users. You can apply their existing curated application data without having to manually add granular details, thus simplifying the overall application segment configuration process. This creates an easy starting point for organizations to begin using the Zero Trust framework, and provides an easier way to change the data for evolving application segments.
Application Segment Import provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: Use existing application data for application segment configuration.
Easily update the data for an application segment if it changes.

blocks.heading: About the Application Segment Import Page

blocks.text: On the Application Segment Import page (Private Access > Private Applications > Application Segment Import), you can do the following:

blocks.item: View a list of applied filters available from the current and previous user sessions. Applied filters must be saved to the user session first before they can be viewed. Use the drop-down menu to select the applied filters to view. To learn more, see Using Tables.
Hide the filters on the page by clicking Hide Filters. Click Show Filters to display the filters.
Import a CSV file containing database files.
Download a sample CSV template to add data.
Select multiple application segments to merge.
Modify the columns displayed in the table.
View details about the application segment.
Go to the Diagnostics Page to view the application segment and its details.
Download the application segment as a CSV file.
